full_judgment: "I. Because the trial Court having found that the alleged power of attorney (on the basis of which alleged sale deed was executed and registered) in favour of Azizul Islam is not valid document in respect of the suit property and aforesaid finding having been made by the trial Court on consideration of oral and documentary evidence, the High Court Division erred in taking, a contradictory view regarding the said power of attorney without considering the oral and documentary evidence and thus the judgment of the High Court Division is not proper judgment of reversal.
